# Rowan’s first room

A short account of moving to a room above a bakery, and the yellow mug that stayed as the room changed.

[Read the moving-home story](The%20moving-home%20story.md). Its notes lead to [selected source excerpts](Sources/Selected%20excerpts.md), with a route back to the story.

This local reading draft is for Rowan to review before sharing with an older sister. It contains wholly fictional test material. It has not been sent or published.
